description: Inspect one mutant of a saved `fallow mutation` JSON report (default: the report that the last run saved in the Fallow cache): original and mutated code, covering tests, and the killing test. A source_sha256 mismatch with the current file gives a stale status, not a wrong answer. This tool never runs tests. A report needs the CLI command `fallow mutation`, which executes the project's tests, so ask your host first. On a Rust root, it reads only the cached map of `cargo fallow mutants`.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Used only
without `report`, as for `config`. Defaults to false and never grants
process-global trust.

config.description:
Path to a fallow config file. Used only without `report`, to find the
cache directory that holds the report of the last run.

mutant_id.description: The `mutant_id` from a mutation plan or report.

package.description:
The Cargo package of a Rust workspace with more than one package.
Valid only on a Rust workspace.

report.description:
Path to a saved `fallow mutation` report or `mutation_plan` output.
A relative path resolves against `root`. Without `root`, it resolves
against the working directory of the MCP server. Omitted: the report
that the last `fallow mutation` run saved in the Fallow cache of the
project.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

name: mutation_inspect
